note: Oglethorpe County's official zoning districts are published by the county (mspoonerOCBOC ArcGIS Online org) as 'Zoning_Districts' and 'The Official Zoning Map of Oglethorpe County_ Georgia_WFL1' feature services, but both return 'Token Required' (code 499) on every query, and the item data download returns 403 'Subscription is disabled'. The county's zoning map viewer is a qPublic (Schneider) app that is behind a Cloudflare check and draws from no public service. No public, unauthenticated zoning district service was found, so the county is recorded as login-required.
